name: L.1T

functions.note: drive greater than 1.35V to exit low-power mode when in battery-powered mode (internal 900k pull-down).
connect to GND to disable the LDO output (battery charging will be unaffected).

ldoEnable.label: LDO output enabled
ldoEnable.description: On-tile LDO output. When true (default), pad 3 (SW) is left floating and the LDO is on. To disable, tie pad 3 to GND.

lowPowerMode.label: Low-power mode
lowPowerMode.description: When enabled (default), pad 2 (LP) is left low and the chip stays in ultra-low-power mode with the I2C interface disabled. To use I2C, set false: pad 2 must be driven > 1.35V (e.g., wired to V+ rail or a Core GPIO output held high).

headline: single-cell Li-Ion charge controller with adjustable LDO output
description: Perfect for wearables and compact battery-powered devices, the Power.L1.T tile integrates a single-cell Lithium-Ion battery charger with a max charge current of 500mA with a programmable LDO output and a 12-bit ADC for battery and system monitoring.

application_notes.details: When a battery is first connected, the IC will enter the ultra-low-current ship mode, which it will exit when voltage is first applied to the SUPPLY pads.  Ship mode can be re-entered either programmatically or by disconnecting/reconnecting the battery.
application_notes.heading: Existing Ship Mode

application_notes.details: When the SW pad is floating, the LDO output will be connected.  Connect SW to GND/SUPPLY- to turn off the output.
application_notes.heading: Normally-On Operation

application_notes.details: In the default low-power mode, the I2C interface is disabled.  To exit low-power mode, drive the LP to greater than 1.35V.
application_notes.heading: Low-Power Mode

application_notes.details: The LDO output can supply up to 150mA in a range from 0.6-3.7V in 0.1V steps.  The power-on default output is set to 1.8V, and can be adjusted by writing to the LDOCTRL register.
application_notes.heading: adjustable LDO output
